name: Typeless
summary: Turns messy spoken thoughts into clear writing in any app; Free is 0 €, and Pro is 11 € per member per month billed yearly or 27 € billed monthly.
description: Typeless is a voice dictation product for macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS and Android that turns messy thoughts into clear writing in any app, with translation and a personal dictionary. Enterprise is custom. TAAFT listed Typeless in this window; the product may already have been on the market before that listing, so it is flagged as possibly older than a first launch.

pricing.details: Free per member (limited words, standard accuracy); Pro 11 €/member/month billed yearly or 27 €/member/month billed monthly (unlimited words, enhanced accuracy, cloud sync and team billing). Enterprise custom.
